protocol.name: ofwc_ipc_unstable_v1

description.summary: ofwc extras for status bars (used by nibar)

protocol.description:
Things a status bar needs that dwl-ipc-unstable-v2 does not carry: the keyboard layouts and a way to run one of the compositor's own actions (the ones of the "keys" list, such as togglefloating). It is optional: a bar must work without it, only without these two features.
Warning! This protocol is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made.

interface.name: zofwc_ipc_v1
interface.description: Exposed as a global. After binding the client receives keyboard_layouts and keyboard_layout; both are sent again whenever they change.

event.name: keyboard_layouts
event.description: The xkb layouts of the keyboard, in order, separated by commas ("us,ru"). Variants in parentheses ("us(intl)") may be present.

event.name: keyboard_layout
event.description: Index in the list of keyboard_layouts of the layout in use.

request.name: set_keyboard_layout
request.description: An index outside of the list is ignored.

request.name: action

description.summary: run an action of the compositor

request.description: Runs the action with this name and argument as if a key bound to it was pressed, on the monitor of `output` if there is one. Unknown actions are ignored; "spawn" and "moveresize" are not available.
